$meta.name: Verst design v5 "За рулём"
$meta.units: dp for sizes, sp for font sizes, em for letter-spacing, ms for durations
$meta.colorFormat: value = #RRGGBB (opaque); optional alpha 0..1 applied on top
$meta.naming: JSON path a.b.c == Kotlin DesignTokens.a.b.c (identical identifiers)

base.use: App background; root of Windshield, Navigator, Drive, Exit

raised.use: Dashboard surface; root of Instruments, Road ahead, Waybill

control.use: Bezels: navigator frame, start-button bezel, instrument-well border, dashboard rim line, secondary button fill

controlAlt.use: Keys (- / +), mirror bezel and stem, info chips

pressed.use: Pressed row background on dashboard surfaces (mockup :hover)

outline.use: Outline buttons (заменить, Сохранить офлайн); filled seat background

outlineDashed.use: Empty-seat dashed border; front-passenger chip border when off

bench.use: Back bench inside the large mirror

pole.use: Static roadside poles; itinerary row connector stub

glass.use: Mirror glass background and crew silhouettes in the small mirror

glare.use: Diagonal glare band on the small mirror

label.use: Mirror caption, back links on sky, adult silhouette in the large mirror

note.use: Stop note line on Road ahead

onLight.use: Text and pictograms on white or yellow

onLightMuted.use: Small label on the white Waybill button

disabled.use: Disabled glyphs and labels (WCAG-exempt, still >= 3:1 on #161618)

blue.use: GOST blue: overhead sign, service signs, exit sign, hotel button, city badge

blueSelected.use: Selected overhead-sign row (AA fix; mockup rgba(255,255,255,.14) = #3E68B0 gives yellow 3.82:1)

bluePressed.use: Pressed overhead-sign row and pressed blue button

blueText.use: Small text on blue signs (header, footer)

plate.use: Loading placeholder plates on blue signs

white.use: City sign plate, sign borders, pictogram plates

yellow.use: Selection, primary CTAs, prices, focus ring; dark backgrounds only

yellowPressed.use: Pressed yellow CTA; pressed yellow link (mockup a:hover)

redText.use: Red text on dark: gauge "E", overspend, offline plate (AA fix; #D8402B = 4.27:1 on well)

field.use: Inputs and chips on the navigator; selected hotel row

fieldBorder.use: Input border; outline button border; street badge

hint.use: Placeholder and section labels on the navigator (AA fix; mockup #5F7487 = 3.34:1 on field)

dashed.use: Dashed button borders (text identifies the control)

radio.use: Unselected radio ring (WCAG 1.4.11 fix; mockup #3A5266 = 2.31:1 on screen)

sun.use: Sun disc; town lights on Exit

roadEdge.use: Road edge lines and lane dashes

sky.use: City-walk scene: evening sky behind the facades (= sky.band1)

facadeC.use: City scene: far facades and roof line

window.use: Lit windows and shop fronts (= scene.sun tone)

lamp.use: Street-lamp heads and their glow core

sidewalk.use: Pavement of the walk column and the city scene

footprint.use: Moving footprints in the walk column

mat.use: Photo frame background: placeholder, letterbox mat, loading base

scrim.use: Bottom gradient behind the photo credit (alpha at the bottom edge)

credit.use: Photo credit text on the scrim

border.use: 1 dp inner border of the photo frame (keeps white photos from bleeding into white text)

phBar.use: Placeholder mat: bar, рюмочная, pub, craft

phCity.use: Placeholder mat: town, hotel area, other

fill.use: Category tag fill (МУЗЕЙ, ПАРК…) on rows and cards (Sprint 4)
«РАЗМИНКА N МИН» tag fill (fun preset stops)

open.use: Opening hours «открыто» text / dot (Sprint 4 walks, cards)

fill.use: Green info plate fill: how the walk was adapted to the crew
Odometer tag under a Road-ahead sign («193 км»)

scrim.use: Scrim behind bottom sheets and dialogs (new)

returnFlash.use: Returned-row highlight on Road ahead / walk list (motion.returnToItem)

xl.use: Windshield caption title, Exit town name

sm.use: Day name, hotel option name and price

mdTight.use: Caption meta lines, hints, back links

credit.use: Photo credit on the scrim «Фото: … · Wikimedia Commons»

label.use: «ФОТО РАЙОНА» label over a hotel-area photo (uppercase copy)

kind.use: Street plate small line «улица», house number

odometer.use: Odometer tag «193 км» under a Road-ahead sign

hours.use: Opening-hours line on a timed walk / card

hoursLg.use: Opening-hours pill on an untimed walk («без ограничения»)

label.use: Form labels, reserve sub-line, footnote (mockup 10-11 sp)

sm.use: Stamp outer words (decorative, hidden from TalkBack)

r5.use: Tourist sign outer; small sign inner border

r6.use: Overhead inner border; badge; odometer frame; flying sign outer

r8.use: Small buttons; exit sign outer; clip

r10.use: Fields, keys, hotel rows, dashed buttons

w2.use: Sign inner border, focus ring, seat border

w3.use: City sign border, start ring, mirror bezel S, road edge (itinerary)

mirrorText.use: Text shadow under the mirror caption

photoW.use: Place-card photo frame width at 390 (= sheet content width; stretches L20/R20)

photoH.use: Card photo frame height = width / 1.5 (3:2 fixed aspect, ADR-0012 §6)

handoffCtaH.use: Road-ahead «Вести в навигаторе» button min height

frameBudgetMs.use: Per-frame budget at 60 fps (scene draw <= 4 ms)
